unit.why: A single anecdote about the Maggid: a poor man asks him for dowry money, the angry Maggid says he will give him fever, and a rich man with fever is then told to give the poor man 200 gold coins in order to be healed.

stories.start_quote: עו״ש מהמגיד ז"ל שהיה בא אליו
stories.end_quote: מה שאמר לו המגיד זצ״ל מקודם
stories.summary_en: A poor man asks the Maggid for money to marry off his grown daughter; the Maggid angrily says 'I will give you fever'; an hour later a rich man suffering from fever comes for help and is told to give the poor man 200 gold pieces to be cured, and the poor man then understands the Maggid's words.
